marketplace.name: ai-catalog
marketplace.description: Reusable Claude Code skills and agents for common software engineering workflows: issue-to-PR cycle, repository bootstrap, per-stack coding, quality gates and documentation.

plugins.name: iru-core
plugins.description: Stack-independent skills: issue-to-PR cycle (issue, explore, plan, code, PR description and review), release, ticket intake, license and security checks, Antora docs, repository bootstrap front door, database tasks, and the iru-gate-runner, iru-isolated-skill-executor and iru-change-summarizer agents. Required by every other plugin.

plugins.name: iru-knowledge
plugins.description: Knowledge-base skills: set up a project knowledge base, process the inbox, compact and complete entries, brief a session, and turn knowledge into GitHub issues or Jira tickets.

plugins.name: iru-java
plugins.description: Java and Kotlin (Maven or Gradle) libraries: coding, tests, JaCoCo/Kover coverage, Checkstyle/PMD/SpotBugs and detekt/ktlint quality gates, Javadoc/KDoc audits, version bumps and repository bootstrap.

plugins.name: iru-springboot
plugins.description: Spring Boot services in Java or Kotlin: multi-module reactor generation (pom, modules, APIs, Hilla, Testcontainers, platform, workflows), coding, performance tests, rolling deployments and Antora documentation.

plugins.name: iru-quarkus
plugins.description: Quarkus services in Java or Kotlin: service scaffold, GitHub workflows, repository bootstrap and task coding.

plugins.name: iru-dotnet
plugins.description: .NET libraries, services and Windows desktop apps (WPF, WinUI 3, Windows Forms): coding, tests, coverage, StyleCop/analyzers, DocFX, version bumps and repository bootstrap.

plugins.name: iru-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript libraries and web apps (React, Angular, Ionic, Hilla): coding, Vitest/Jest/ng tests, coverage, ESLint/Prettier quality, TSDoc, version bumps and repository bootstrap.

plugins.name: iru-nestjs
plugins.description: NestJS services: task coding and application scaffold.

plugins.name: iru-nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js web apps: task coding and application scaffold.

plugins.name: iru-react-native
plugins.description: React Native apps (Expo or bare CLI/Metro): task coding, version bumps and application scaffold.

plugins.name: iru-php
plugins.description: PHP projects (Laravel, WordPress plugins and themes, PrestaShop modules): coding, Pest/PHPUnit tests, coverage, PHPStan/Psalm/PHPCS quality, PHPDoc, version bumps and repository bootstrap.

plugins.name: iru-python
plugins.description: Python projects (FastAPI and Django): coding, pytest tests, coverage, Ruff/mypy/Bandit quality, docstring audits, version bumps and repository bootstrap.

plugins.name: iru-android
plugins.description: Android libraries and Compose apps in Kotlin: coding, unit tests, coverage, Lint/detekt/ktlint quality, Dokka audits, version bumps and repository bootstrap.

plugins.name: iru-swift
plugins.description: Swift packages and Apple apps (iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS): coding, tests, coverage, SwiftLint, DocC, version bumps and repository bootstrap.

plugins.name: iru-kmp
plugins.description: Kotlin Multiplatform Android and iOS apps: coding, host tests, Kover coverage, detekt/ktlint/Lint/SwiftLint quality, Dokka audits, version bumps and repository bootstrap.

plugins.name: iru-rust
plugins.description: Rust crates and workspaces: coding, nextest/cargo test, llvm-cov coverage, clippy/rustfmt/cargo-deny quality, rustdoc audits, version bumps and gitignore scaffold.

plugins.name: iru-go
plugins.description: Go modules: coding, go test, coverage, golangci-lint/go vet/govulncheck quality, godoc audits, version bumps and gitignore scaffold.

plugins.name: iru-cli
plugins.description: Agent-friendly command-line tools in Rust, Go, Swift or .NET: scaffolds that implement the Building CLIs for AI Agents contract, shared GitHub workflows and the repository orchestrator.

optional_calls.reason: iru-setup-repository (and the iru-code dispatch table) delegate to whichever stack plugin is installed for the detected project type; a missing stack plugin degrades to a report, never a hard dependency (core is required by every stack, so a dependency would be circular)
iru-typescript-* skills route React Native tasks to iru-react-native-*; only taken when the project is React Native, and iru-react-native already depends on iru-typescript
